_about: Informational questions shown beside the voice rungs (forecast/voice.py, tracking()). They never feed rungs A-C. 'anchors' are dated judgements, newest used; between them the probability runs down by the rule in 'rule'. To revise the judgement, append an anchor with a reason; never edit an old one. Set 'resolution' by hand (DAILY_RUNBOOK.md 12, Voice watch); never change it once set.

questions.short: Any material voice update by Dec 31, 2026
questions.question: By 2026-12-31, does Anthropic ship or officially announce a material voice update?
questions.label: judgement, not a model output

reason.text: On 23 July 2026 Anthropic told Engadget: "We're continuing to invest in voice and we'll have more to share later this year." This question asks whether that happens, in any form. Rungs A to C ask only about a speech model of Anthropic's own.
reason.quote: We're continuing to invest in voice and we'll have more to share later this year.

counts: A new voice-mode capability in a Claude product, stated on a first-party page (anthropic.com, claude.com, support.claude.com, platform.claude.com, code.claude.com): for example full-duplex or interruptible conversation, a new Voice screen or app surface made public, spoken replies in a product that had none, or the Fable line in voice mode.
A voice or audio API: an audio input or output type, a speech or realtime endpoint, or audio pricing in the API docs.
A first-party speech model with any outside access (this also resolves rung A).
An official announcement of any of these, dated on or before the deadline, even if access comes later.
does_not_count: Bug fixes, reliability work and dictation tweaks.
Wording or date changes to help pages; privacy or data-collection changes.
Features that only transcribe (such as Claude Meetings, 2026-11-12), and third-party integrations or partner products.
Leaks, hidden interface items, job postings and press reports without a first-party page.
questions.rule: The latest dated judgement fixes a constant daily rate over the days then left to the deadline (low-hazard days such as the holiday freeze count a quarter, as in the forecasts). Each day that passes with nothing shipped leaves fewer days, so the probability runs down to zero at the deadline. A daily run may replace the judgement with a new dated one and a reason.

anchors.reason: Judgement. For: an on-record promise for this year; a recordings opt-in (Oct 4) and a hidden Voice / Preview item (Oct 10); the 2025 voice mode shipped 43 days after its first hidden-interface sighting; three voice help pages edited on Nov 9. Against: nothing in 117 days since the statement; about two material voice updates a year so far (May 2025, June and July 2026), which alone gives about one in five for the time left; the one earlier 'later this year' statement delivered one of its two models; the holiday freeze from Dec 20; dated calls miss late.

resolution.note: outcome is 'yes' or 'no'. Yes needs a first-party page opened by the run. With nothing by the deadline it grades No on 2027-01-01.
